name: Willem Dafoe Looking Up
look: A blurry, blue-tinted frame of a bearded Willem Dafoe in front of a rough stone wall, tilting his head back and gazing upward with wide eyes and a slightly open mouth, under a strip of empty white space at the top.
use: A reaction of awe, wonder or dread at something looming above. The caption goes in the white space and names the overwhelming thing he's staring up at, like a mountain of chores or a giant staircase.
slots: what he's staring up at (white space at top)
examples: Me at the bottom of the stairs the day after leg day
describe: willem dafoe staring up in awe
man staring up at the sky with wide eyes in blue light
guy tilting his head back amazed at something huge
actor gazing upward with his mouth open
dafoe looking up at something scary or amazing
